name: amigosecreto-theme
description: Tema WordPress para sorteio de amigo secreto (Parcel + Tailwind + Swup + React)

scripts.dev: node scripts/parcel.js watch src/js/app.js src/css/app.css --dist-dir dist --no-hmr --public-url ./
scripts.build: node scripts/parcel.js build src/js/app.js src/css/app.css --dist-dir dist --no-source-maps --no-cache --public-url ./
